selection_rule: Union of all common-stock identities listed in QQQ September 30, 2012 and DIA October 31, 2012 schedules; deduplicate the same historical issuer. No ranking by subsequent performance or current index membership.
evidence_cap: DISCOVERY ONLY. Conditioning on currently retrievable continuous historical series creates survivor/availability bias even though original membership is contemporaneously documented. Unavailable and unresolved identities remain in this manifest. No unbiased historical-alpha or original-index-replication claim is permitted.
eligibility_policy: research_eligible is provisional identity eligibility, not a successful download or return-based selection. Require full trading-session coverage and source metadata identity checks before including a symbol. Preserve every rejection and reason. Never fill a missing delisting outcome with zero, silently drop losing names, or substitute an acquirer's pre-merger history. No 2023+ strategy outcomes were examined to create this file.
scope_note: 127 unique historical identities preserve the complete union rather than deleting seven to satisfy an approximate 120-name preference. QQQ includes foreign issuers and ADRs listed in the US.
